user.description: Use the email and **passphrase** of your Folding@home account (the login for app.foldingathome.org, not the donor passkey). Every machine linked to the account is added automatically. The passphrase is only used to unlock the account key and is not stored.

solar.title: Solar control
solar.description:
Machine: **{machine}**

Fold on spare solar power and stop when it runs out. A manual Fold or Pause is kept until the next solar change.

data.solar_surplus_entity: Surplus power sensor (W or kW, positive = spare power)
data.solar_start_w: Start folding when surplus is at least
data.solar_start_delay: Surplus must last this long before starting
data.solar_stop_delay: Shortfall must last this long before stopping
data.solar_finish_above: Smart stop: finish if work unit progress is at least
data.solar_min_soc: Only start when battery is at least
data.solar_max_import_w: Stop when grid import exceeds (0 = off)

data_description.solar_surplus_entity: With a zero-export limit the inverter curtails spare power, so use a template sensor such as PV power minus house load (house load must include this machine). Negative values mean you are using more than the panels make.
data_description.solar_stop_w: Must be lower than the start threshold. The machine's own draw lowers the surplus once it starts, so leave a gap at least as big as its power draw.
data_description.solar_start_w: With several machines, stagger the start thresholds (e.g. 300 W, 600 W, 900 W) so they start one after another.
data_description.solar_priority: With several machines on solar control: lower-priority machines start only after all higher-priority ones are folding, and stop first when the sun fades. Machines with the same number work independently.
